name: Dan Yung
source: 45 years old and Ryo’s father. He is happily married to his wife, Sun Yung. Dan was once a famed zoologist until a colleague of his plagiarized his work and took credit for it, leaving Dan with nothing but a bad reputation. Dan is currently unemployed and trying to come up with a new study to regain his fame. Dan is quiet, reserved, and very rarely if ever gets into an argument. He does his best to comfort everyone around him while hiding his own emotions.
